thread:
morgan: Heads-up: I'm prototyping a 'preflight replay' feature in Console so teams can rehearse config flips without risking production traffic. Thoughts?
kai: Love it. We desperately need something clearer than "dry-run". Key asks: non-blocking, privacy-safe, and a compact safety verdict we can wire into rollout pipelines.
yasmine: Agreed. Two modes: 'staging-replay' that mirrors a tiny percent to a replay runner, and 'profile-forecast' that uses perf profiles to model cost/latency.
morgan: Implementation sketch (API):
```
POST /internal/config/preflight
{
  "config_id": "route_weights_v2",
  "mode": "staging-replay",
  "sample_pct": 3,
  "window_mins": 45,
  "exclude_tenants": ["gov-uk"]
}
```
kai: For staging-replay we must not double live traffic. Mirror must be asynchronous + rate-limited and honor backend capacity. If runner detects backend_saturation > 0.6 it should auto-pause and mark verdict INCONCLUSIVE.
ops-bot: Runbook: "On INCONCLUSIVE -> notify #eng-oncall, attach last-run metrics, do not allow automated rollout."
yasmine: Telemetry contract: emit a single artifact 'preflight_summary' with tags: config_id, mode, sample_pct, p50_delta_ms, p95_delta_ms, error_delta_ppm, cost_delta_usd, confidence_low, confidence_high, sample_count. Sink to 'config-preflight' topic.
lina: UX idea: show a compact safety badge (green/yellow/red) + 3-line summary and a link to raw replay logs. Also show estimated monthly cost delta extrapolated from sample.
morgan: Ownership? I'll take the Console surface and the audit logging (who ran it, why). @kai can you take the replay-runner?
kai: I'll own runner + saturation probes. Plan: sampled mirror -> scrub -> enqueue -> run replay against staging model endpoints with reduced concurrency. Also add tenant-consent check for EU tenants.
yasmine: I'll wire telemetry and add the dashboard tile with historical preflight verdicts and a pass/fail predicate builder. Suggest default predicate: p95_delta_ms < 12 AND error_delta_ppm < 200 AND cost_delta_pct < 6. Make predicate configurable per-route.
morgan: small nit: we need to be explicit about scrubbing rules (remove user IDs, prompt texts, PII). Lina, can you coordinate with privacy/legal on masking policy?
lina: On it. If tenant consent is missing we should default to profile-forecast mode and log the fallback reason.
kai: Also: make sure simulation requests are rate-limited per-tenant and globally. Replay-runner should maintain a running estimate of additional CPU/GPU cost and report it in the summary.
morgan: Audit: every preflight must be recorded with initiator, config diff snapshot, and preflight_summary id. Ops should be able to revoke a preflight result.
ops-bot: Reminder: Log requests to audit with initiator + timestamp. Include region and tenant flags.
yasmine: For rollout automation, expose an API that returns a boolean 'safe_to_rollout' plus reason codes so CI can gate deployments. Example: { safe: false, reasons: ["p95_delta: +30ms", "backend_saturation: 0.72"] }
kai: Good. I'll also add a configurable "max-sample-pct" knob in runtime to prevent accidental large mirrors.
lina: I'll draft the privacy checklist and loop legal into the PR. Also will draft the UI copy for consent flows.
morgan: Timeline: prototype API + console mock this week behind a runtime flag, runner + basic telemetry next week. If no objections, I'll open the draft PR.
yasmine: No objections from me. One suggestion: include confidence intervals prominently so teams don't over-trust small samples.
kai: Agreed. Also add an auto-schedule option for longer window runs to improve confidence for low-traffic routes.
morgan: Awesome. I'll open the PR and tag owners. If anyone wants to tighten predicate thresholds for latency-sensitive routes we can make route-level overrides.
